title: Brand Brain + Review & Control Design Remediation

notes: Implements UI-05 from issue #94 using the approved Kairo design baseline and shared product shell.
Every inferred or stale Brand Brain field becomes explicit human review work; confirmed owner truth remains authoritative.
The advanced editor and Knowledge source management move to progressive disclosure without changing persistence or source contracts.
VS-55 Universal URL/PDF behaviour is preserved unchanged; no API, database, OAuth/provider, model, publishing or deployment changes are authorized.
Vercel Git-triggered deployment remains disabled and this slice has no deployment approval.

approvals.rationale: Owner approved proceeding with UI-05 Brand Brain + Review & Control as the next bounded Kairo remediation slice.
This slice preserves approved FR-02/FR-03/FR-04 truth, inference, provenance and Knowledge-source contracts and makes no new policy decision.
Owner instructed Go ahead, authorizing bounded UI implementation, deterministic tests, UI review and exact-head certification gates. Merge and deployment remain separate approvals.

Implementation-level UI Review passed and the initial implementation head passed Product Intake #585, Security #678 and CI #793. Final certification requires the same gates on the frozen post-governance candidate SHA.
Separate exact-SHA release approval is required.
